Stories discussed in this episode:

  • Apple reports Q3 2026 earnings: $109.4 billion revenue, 16% YoY growth
  • Apple stock drops ~10% at open on mixed Q3 2026 earnings
  • Apple warns supply constraints will 'significantly' worsen next quarter
  • Tim Cook completes final analyst call of his tenure, confirming Ternus as successor
  • App Store regulatory changes begin to weigh on Apple Services growth
  • Apple's latest acquisition makes a lot of sense for its product roadmap
